name: Benign Metanephric Tumor

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Histopathological and Immunohistochemical Diagnostic Criteria for Metanephric Adenoma

criteria.description: Presence of small, uniform epithelial cells arranged in tightly packed acini and tubules with scant cytoplasm
Positive staining for WT1 and negative for CK7 and AMACR
Well-circumscribed, hypovascular renal mass on CT or MRI without evidence of local invasion or metastasis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation with characteristic immunohistochemical profile; imaging supportive but not definitive
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Molecular testing for BRAF V600E mutation may aid in diagnosis but is not mandatory

pathognomonic.symptomName: Well-circumscribed, non-invasive renal tumor on imaging
searchTerms: well-defined kidney tumor not invading nearby tissue
kidney tumor with clear borders and no spread

occasional.symptomName: Hypertension secondary to renal mass effect
searchTerms: high blood pressure from kidney mass
blood pressure increase due to renal growth

occasional.symptomName: Mild constitutional symptoms such as fatigue

laboratory: Microscopic or gross hematuria on urinalysis
Elevated hematocrit in cases with polycythemia
imaging: Well-defined, hypovascular renal mass on CT or MRI
Absence of local invasion or metastasis on imaging
genetic: Presence of BRAF V600E mutation in tumor cells
other: Histopathology showing small uniform epithelial cells with acinar and tubular architecture
Immunohistochemistry positive for WT1, negative for CK7 and AMACR

distinguishingFeatures: Malignant behavior with potential for metastasis
Positive staining for CK7 and AMACR
Triphasic histology with blastemal, epithelial, and stromal components

redFlags: Evidence of local invasion or metastasis on imaging
references: Argani P, et al. Metanephric adenoma: a clinicopathologic study of 28 cases. Am J Surg Pathol. 2001.
Tickoo SK, et al. Metanephric adenoma: a clinicopathologic study of 48 cases. Am J Surg Pathol. 2006.
